status: Provided by Modwerk's Digitakt mk1 base (sdk/machines/digitakt/base, version 5.0) for OS 1.53 and 1.54, which builds and links every shipped mod unchanged; until a tester has run it on a unit, site builds keep linking the catalogue's core. Mods written for this interface link with either.

events.name: ev_tick
events.handler: void f(ctrl); set ctrl+0x20 to recompose

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS draws the screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(brain, KeyEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(brain, EncoderEvent*); nonzero takes it

events.name: ev_render_voices
events.when: in the render, after playback has written every track's block, before the overdrive
events.handler: void f(int32_t *blocks); blocks = 8 tracks x 32 Q31 samples. Order 10-49 makes a track's sound, 50-89 changes one already made

tables.name: core_machines
tables.purpose: Pointers to descriptors for SRC machine ids 4–127 (six longs; with the tag "UI30" and a page pointer after them, the machine describes its own SRC and LFO pages); the OS lists, names, sets, loads and renders them as the stock machine they stand in for.

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS row from an ev_settings handler.

exports.name: core_track_machine
exports.purpose: Each track's own machine id as the render last took it.

exports.name: core_machine
exports.purpose: The added machine descriptor for an id, or zero.

exports.name: core_zero
exports.purpose: What a weak import resolves to when no mod provides it.

exports.name: core_machine_ui
exports.purpose: An added machine's SRC page (descriptor +28 when +24 is "UI30"), or zero.

exports.name: cm_ui_v3
exports.purpose: The page marker an added machine's page names in its abi field.

exports.name: cm_ui_v31
exports.purpose: The marker of a page whose knobs may draw their own graphic (DRAW).
